disposition_mapping.rationale: Explicitly unconstrained by design and unanimously treated by the council as mechanically continuous with extraction. Merged into T1, with the majority's caveat (emerging_economy, finance_domain, hitl_designer) that a permanent manual/paper intake lane and channel/timestamp provenance survive rather than being modelled as a shrinking exception queue.

Also unconstrained by design; merges with VIP-01 into a single capture-and-validation pipeline. The council's near-universal position (pragmatist, finance_domain, agentic_architect, emerging_economy, hitl_designer) is preserved: automation runs unattended on high-confidence extractions, but low-confidence/anomalous records route to a human validator with source-document visibility, and the audit trail distinguishes machine-only from human-affirmed records (hitl_designer's non-negotiable, adopted by emerging_economy and finance_domain in round 2).

Retained as its own addressable, reportable step, rejecting maximalist's fold into a merged intake/match/authorize pipeline. Six of seven council members (pragmatist, finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards, emerging_economy) held that matching needs an independent trigger and log distinguishable from surrounding steps, both for reportability (pragmatist, finance_domain) and because KB-09 ties the PO-GRN-invoice evidence chain to IAS 2 cost measurement, not merely fraud control (accounting_standards). Restructured to add explicit tolerance-band automation, full evidence-lineage logging on every match including clean ones, and an explicit non-PO bypass route (finance_domain, accounting_standards, agentic_architect all converged on this gap), satisfying VIP-R-01/R-02.

Retained as a distinct, human-decisioned step rather than absorbed into an automated pipeline. This resolves the round-2 conflict directly against maximalist's auto-resolution-with-escalation model: hitl_designer's bright line ('no auto-resolution of exceptions... a human must affirm every exception outcome'), agentic_architect's siding with that line, accounting_standards' KB-05 reading, finance_domain, pragmatist and emerging_economy all converge against maximalist alone. Restructured to add an agent-assisted investigation copilot (draft only, never decides) and an explicit accrual-candidate output closing the GRNI/KB-01/KB-04 linkage that maximalist, agentic_architect and accounting_standards all separately conceded was missing in round 1.

Retained as a step organisationally and system-permission distinct from posting (VIP-R-03, VIP-R-04, VIP-R-06). Restructured into risk-tiered approval: policy-encoded auto-approval for clean, sub-threshold, non-exception invoices, attributed to a named policy owner and policy version (the position shared by hitl_designer, finance_domain and agentic_architect against pragmatist's insistence on a named individual approver for every invoice). This is a deliberate synthesis decision, not a split: pragmatist's concern is addressed instead by hitl_designer's hard rule, adopted here, that any invoice touched by exception resolution always requires a named human approver regardless of value, and by the requirement that auto-approval remain logged, reversible before posting, and periodically reviewable by the approver hierarchy.

Non-negotiable across the entire council: GL posting must survive as a distinct step, structurally separate from approval (VIP-R-05, VIP-R-06), because it is the accrual recognition event under KB-01 and the determinable recognition moment under KB-11 (accounting_standards), not a passive pass-through of approval (finance_domain's explicit warning, echoed by accounting_standards in round 2). Restructured to automate mechanical coding while preserving human review for judgment-laden allocations and for accrual-candidate records forwarded from exception resolution, addressing the succession-risk point raised by emerging_economy and finance_domain.

Retained as its own step; payment execution survives per VIP-R-08 and must follow approval per VIP-R-04. Restructured around agentic_architect's irreversibility framing, adopted convergently by hitl_designer, finance_domain and emerging_economy: everything upstream is a reversible internal state, but bank-file transmission is not, so a maker-checker human release gate is placed specifically there, independent of upstream approval. Mandatory bank-detail-change verification (finance_domain, hitl_designer, emerging_economy, agentic_architect all independently required this) and tracked, non-netted exchange differences (KB-08, accounting_standards) are made explicit, and a manual/asynchronous fallback is retained rather than assuming continuous connectivity or standardised rails (emerging_economy), declining maximalist's always-on 'continuous payment optimization' framing as the reference design.

AP reconciliation survives per VIP-R-07 and KB-03's cutoff discipline. Restructured to run continuous automated tie-out feeding a discrete, named human period-end sign-off, rejecting the notion (challenged by pragmatist, finance_domain and accounting_standards) that a real-time dashboard state can itself constitute a reconciliation or a certification. The step is explicitly linked back to T3/T5's accrual-candidate records so unresolved GRNI-type items are captured as documented accrual lines before period certification, closing the loop accounting_standards, hitl_designer and agentic_architect all identified as missing from round-1 designs.

steps.actor: AP clerk supervising automated capture/OCR engine, with manual intake lane retained as a first-class path
steps.description: Multi-channel intake (portal, EDI, email PDF, scan, permanent paper lane) and OCR/AI extraction run as a single continuous pipeline producing a structured, validated invoice record (vendor ID, invoice number, dates, amounts, currency, line items, tax, PO reference) with a per-field confidence score. High-confidence extractions pass straight through; low-confidence or anomalous records (duplicate numbers, unrecognized vendor, malformed header, poor-quality scan) route to a human validator who sees the source document image side-by-side with extracted fields, not a bare confirm button. Every record carries channel/timestamp provenance and an explicit flag distinguishing machine-only from human-affirmed data, and confidence thresholds are locally calibrated rather than imported from vendor benchmarks, since non-Latin scripts and degraded scans are a persistent primary channel in some operating units, not a shrinking legacy tail.
inputs: Vendor invoice (email PDF, EDI, supplier portal or paper)
steps.name: Invoice capture and validation
outputs: Structured validated invoice record with confidence score and provenance metadata

steps.description: The validated invoice record is matched against genuine, independently sourced PO and GRN data through a matching engine with configurable tolerance bands, producing a clean match, a tolerance match, or an exception. Clean and in-tolerance matches require no human touch; every match decision, including auto-clean matches, is logged with the three source records it compared (invoice, PO, GRN) so the invoice-to-GRN-to-PO evidence chain that establishes cost under IAS 2/LKAS 2 remains reconstructible. Invoices with no PO reference (utilities, subscriptions, professional services) are explicitly routed around this step to approval rather than forced through an exception path that would dilute genuine variance reporting. Retained as its own addressable, reportable step rather than folded into intake or authorization, so exception-rate KPIs and match-failure categories remain independently queryable by a controller.
steps.name: Automated three-way matching
outputs: Match result (clean, tolerance or exception) with full PO/GRN evidence lineage
Non-PO invoice population routed directly to approval

steps.description: Invoices flagged as exceptions are investigated by a named AP analyst against variance detail, PO/GRN history and vendor communications, with an investigation copilot permitted to assemble evidence and draft a proposed resolution but never to resolve the exception itself. Every exception outcome above a de minimis threshold requires human affirmation grounded in the actual variance evidence, not a confidence score alone; auto-clearing an exception under the same tolerance policy that already failed to clear it as a clean match is treated as suppression, not correction, and is not permitted. Held or disputed items are explicitly linked forward: where goods have been received but the invoice is unresolved, an accrual-candidate (GRNI-type) record is emitted for GL coding/period close rather than left as a silent open item.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution
outputs: Resolved invoice (approved, rejected or held), human-affirmed
Audit trail recording the evidence reviewed, not only the verdict
Accrual-candidate record for unresolved GRNI-type items

steps.actor: Approver hierarchy (named human approvers for material/exception/non-PO invoices; policy-owner-attributed auto-approval for clean sub-threshold invoices)
steps.description: Matched invoices (clean-matched, coded, below a documented materiality threshold, with no exception history) may be authorised through a policy-encoded auto-approval rule acting under a signed-off delegation of authority, producing a discrete, timestamped, attributable approval record tied to a named policy owner and the policy version applied. Any invoice above the threshold, of non-PO type, or that passed through exception resolution (T3) is always routed to a named human approver in the approval hierarchy regardless of value — exception history overrides auto-approval eligibility as a hard rule. The approval step remains architecturally and organisationally distinct from GL posting (T5): different system role/credentials, no shared execution context, so actor separation is enforced structurally, not just nominally.
steps.name: Risk-tiered approval routing and authorisation
outputs: Fully approved invoice with discrete, attributable approval record (named approver or policy owner + policy version)

steps.actor: AP accountant (distinct system credentials from approval)
steps.description: Mechanical coding to chart of accounts, cost centres and project codes is largely rules-derived from PO/vendor-master data, but the posting event itself — the point at which the payable is recognised as a liability under the accrual basis (IAS 1/LKAS 1, KB-01) and becomes a determinable financial instrument (IFRS 9/SLFRS 9, KB-11) — remains a distinct, reviewable action performed under a system identity separate from approval (T4), satisfying actor separation (VIP-R-06). Invoices lacking clean PO-derived coding, or accrual-candidate records forwarded from T3, receive human coding review and a documented estimation basis where judgment on value or recoverability is involved (IAS 8/LKAS 8, KB-04), addressing succession risk in concentrated coding expertise.
steps.name: GL coding and posting
outputs: Accrual entries with documented basis for held/disputed items

steps.description: Posted invoices are scheduled against payment terms, vendor bank details and cash position, with file generation automatable but file transmission to the bank treated as the irreversibility boundary: a maker-checker gate requires human release confirmation, distinct from and in addition to upstream approval, before any payment file leaves the organisation. Any vendor bank-detail change or first-time beneficiary forces human verification regardless of amount. Cross-currency payments generate a tracked, reported exchange-difference record rather than a netted figure (IAS 21/LKAS 21, KB-08). Where connectivity or payment-rail standardisation is unreliable, an asynchronous/manual fallback lane is retained rather than assuming continuous bank connectivity.
steps.name: Payment scheduling and execution

steps.description: Bank confirmations, AP subledger and vendor statements are reconciled continuously where tooling allows, surfacing breaks in near-real time, but the period-end balance is confirmed through a discrete, named human sign-off tied to an enforced cutoff/subledger lock (IAS 1/LKAS 1, KB-03), not a dashboard state. Reconciled figures remain traceable back through journals to source evidence (KB-02). Accrual-candidate records and unresolved exception items forwarded from T3/T5 are captured here as named accrual lines with a documented basis before the period is certified, rather than carried forward silently.
inputs: Accrual-candidate records from exception resolution and posting
steps.name: Reconciliation and period close
outputs: Period-end balance confirmed with named sign-off
